message: The other day, I was whipping up a fancy dinner when my smoke alarm decided it was the perfect time to audition for a fire alarm symphony. There I was, flapping a dish towel like a madman, trying to fan the smoke away while my kids were giggling at the chaos. It made me realize how often we think we’re prepared until life throws a little smoke our way! So, I guess it’s a good reminder to have those escape plans in place... just in case the kitchen turns into a comedy show! 😂
